# Matthias Prinz zu Schwarzburg

Official website: https://prinzzuschwarzburg.de/
Language: German
Public contact: info@prinzzuschwarzburg.de
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0001-9603-1762

## Identity
Priv.-Doz. Dr. med. Matthias Prinz zu Schwarzburg is a German physician in otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery, and plastic and aesthetic operations. His work includes functional and aesthetic rhinoplasty and independent medical orientation concerning aesthetic facial treatments.

## Clinical roles
- Kopfzentrum Bielefeld: otorhinolaryngology and functional nasal surgery
- KÖ-KLINIK Düsseldorf: aesthetic rhinoplasty
- President of DIGM e. V. since 2025

## Publications and education
- Book: "Schönheit und ein langes Leben – Was wirkt wirklich?" by Matthias Prinz zu Schwarzburg, Jan Balczun and Holger Sudhoff
- Medical self-study course: "Botox, Filler – oder lieber nichts?"
